short: Costs that rise and fall directly with what you sell.
seoTitle: Variable Cost — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: Variable costs move directly with sales volume — ingredients, packaging, payment gateway charges, aggregator commission and per-order delivery cost.
definition: Variable costs move directly with sales volume — ingredients, packaging, payment gateway charges, aggregator commission and per-order delivery cost. Sell nothing and they are close to zero.
bodyHtml:
Why Variable Cost matters

Variable cost per unit is what sets contribution margin, and therefore what decides whether an extra order or a discounted campaign is worth doing.

Variable Cost formula

Total variable cost = Variable cost per unit × Units sold

Selling price minus variable cost per unit gives contribution margin.

How Variable Cost works in practice

Work them out per unit rather than as a monthly total, because the per-unit figure is what pricing decisions need. Watch for costs that quietly became variable, such as commission on a growing share of online orders.

faq.question: Is electricity a variable cost?
faq.answer: Partly. There is a base load regardless of sales plus a portion that rises with activity, which makes it semi-variable.

faq.question: Is aggregator commission a variable cost?
faq.answer: Yes, and a large one — it scales exactly with the orders it is charged on.
